text: Yedduɓ ɓen qirritoo junuubi maɓɓe ɗin, ka qirritagol tuuba nafataa, ɓe wi'a: joomi amen, A warii men laawi ɗiɗi, tawde men woodanooko, taguɗaa Men, refti waruɗaa men ɓaawo ɗum. Wuurnituɗaa men kadi laawi ɗiɗi, ka tawnoo men woodanooka, e ka wuurnituɗaa men ɗon ummital. Haray men qirrike junuubi ɗi men faggitii ɗin. Taw si laawol no woodi, ka men yaltira e ngee Yiite, men yiltitoo aduna, fii moƴƴingol golle amen, jaɓanaa men ɗe?
